key deletion versus getspecific.evidence_boundary: Stale lookup after reuse passes; API-internal lock request order not witnessed

key deletion versus setspecific.evidence_boundary: Old generation set returns EINVAL after reuse; exact internal overlap absent

key reuse versus stale thread cells.evidence_boundary: T1 holder blocked, T2 delete/reuse index with newer generation, T3 rejects old cell

destructor versus key deletion.evidence_boundary: T4 callback held, T5 deletes key, T6 callback finishes, T7 one callback/two joins

destructor versus key reuse.evidence_boundary: T5 generation reuse occurs while selected callback is held

destructor callback reentrancy.evidence_boundary: T4 creates/sets/gets/deletes temporary key before publishing hold marker

thread exit versus registry cleanup.evidence_boundary: Callback/delete/reuse and Reaped/join ordering witnessed; initial/final-thread paths blocked

detach versus exit.evidence_boundary: Functional detached callbacks and ownership source fix; exact request/acquire ordering not forced

detach versus cleanup sweep.evidence_boundary: Same-lock exclusion repaired; exact observer schedule not forced
